title: React Router new state replace the old state
body:
I install the latest beta version, `beta.20`.

I updated my react-router code from the [example](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/67c75259c8408bea909a9d2a51404aafd00b8dd9/packages/react-instantsearch/examples/react-router/src/App.js) (you can see the code [here](https://github.com/windtoday/windtoday-app/commit/68685d67aaf2ba90189c91a335428a6a497936f7))

The thing that I detected that happen right now is that the new state replace the old state and it hasn't the previous filters applied:

![](https://d17oy1vhnax1f7.cloudfront.net/items/2g1x0G2r0m2H1D3R0S2X/Screen%20Recording%202016-12-07%20at%2001.44%20pm.gif?v=91b32ea9)
